basic_details.job_title: APS Belagavi Science Laboratory Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Army Public School, The Maratha LIRC, Belagavi has released a notification for non-teaching staff, inviting applications for the post of Science Laboratory Attendant up to class XII. Eligible candidates must forward their filled applications by post or by hand to the Principal, Army Public School, Belagavi latest by 18 Nov 2026 (1400 hrs).

age_limit.details: Below 40 years for fresh candidates. Experienced candidates below 57 years (Min. 5 yrs of experience in the last 10 yrs).

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Existing vacancies apply for Upto class XII

qualification.details: 10 + 2 with Science and computer literacy. | Below 40 years for fresh candidates. Experienced candidates below 57 years (Min. 5 yrs of experience in the last 10 yrs).

selection_process: Selection will be made through a panel interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.
important_instructions: Download the application form from www.awesindia.com. No application will be accepted after 18 Nov 2026 (1400 hrs). As per AWES norms, no TA/DA is admissible for attending interviews. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. School contact number for queries: 9141972975. content_sections.heading: About APS Belagavi Science Laboratory Attendant
content_sections.text: Army Public School, The Maratha LIRC, Camp Belagavi operates under AWES norms to recruit qualified non-teaching staff for its institution up to class XII. The recruitment aims to fill the Science Laboratory Attendant position through a panel interview conducted at the school premises in Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications with detailed Bio-data, copies of certificates, copy of score card and mark sheets along with a Demand Draft for Rs 100/- in the name of ARMY PUBLIC SCHOOL, Belagavi should be addressed to The Principal, Army Public School, Belagavi, c/o The MARATHA LIRC, Belagavi (Karnataka)-590009 and reach by post/by hand latest by 18 Nov 2026 (1400 hrs). faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for AWES Science Laboratory Attendant?
faq.answer: The last date to reach the application by post or by hand is 18 Nov 2026 by 1400 hrs.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Science Laboratory Attendant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10 + 2 with Science and possess computer literacy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for fresh candidates applying for this post?
faq.answer: Fresh candidates must be below 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Experienced candidates must be below 57 years, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the last 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay offered for the Science Laboratory Attendant?
faq.answer: The all-inclusive monthly pay ranges from 13,939/- to 16,536/- per month based on experience.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee and how should it be paid?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs 100/- must be paid via a Demand Draft in the name of ARMY PUBLIC SCHOOL, Belagavi.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application must be addressed to The Principal, Army Public School, Belagavi, c/o The MARATHA LIRC, Belagavi (Karnataka)-590009.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is conducted through a panel interview, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.
